name: Large-N gravity arXiv paper
prompt: Revise the article source in {root}/paper/ in place, not in a side file, and rebuild the PDF at {target}. Keep a log of each change at {root}/paper/CHANGES.md. Use no visible windows.
claim: The article was revised in place with a change log, builds cleanly, and no visible window was opened.
rubric: Edits went into the article source itself, not a side file.
A change log lists each edit.
The PDF builds and no figure or equation runs off the page.
The prose is plain and no filler was added.
No visible window or browser was opened.
note: Real job from PLAN.md section 15. Needs the vault as --root and Joe's review. Inputs named in the prompt ({root}/...) are staged by hand before the run.
